osm_report.threat_description:
Infostealer targeting Minecraft accounts, exfiltrating to a Discord webhook (Steal Eyes V2/src/scripts/script_remover.js:119). Payload in Steal Eyes V2/src/scripts/script_remover.js.
Outbound: exfil. It reads credentials (Steal Eyes V2/src/scripts/script_remover.js:52) and sends data out (Steal Eyes V2/src/scripts/script_remover.js:119).
Found by GitHub code search for a confirmed malware signature: "launcher_accounts.json" "api/webhooks".
Confirmed by static analysis; the code was read, never executed.
osm_report.payload_description:
Malicious payload found in: Steal Eyes V2/src/scripts/script_remover.js
- Outbound: exfil. It reads credentials (Steal Eyes V2/src/scripts/script_remover.js:52) and sends data out (Steal Eyes V2/src/scripts/script_remover.js:119).
- Steal Eyes V2/src/scripts/script_remover.js:52: reads Minecraft launcher account stores (Microsoft refresh and access tokens)
- Steal Eyes V2/src/scripts/script_remover.js:119: hardcoded Discord webhook, the drop point for stolen data (+1 more)
